keys: Then the cue ball must touch %@.
Then stop the cue ball on the mark, lined up on %@.
The object ball leaves along the line through both centres at contact. Aim so that line runs into the pocket.
A ball leaves a cushion at about the angle it came in, so aim at the pocket's mirror image in that cushion.
The cue ball comes off the cushion at about its mirror angle, so it can reach a ball it cannot see straight.
Each ball sends the next along the line through their centres, so line up the last contact first.
After a cut, a stunned cue ball leaves at right angles to the object ball's path. That sends it on to the second ball.
Balls that grip as they touch drag each other sideways, so a ball can be thrown off its straight line.
Backspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and pulls the cue ball back.
Topspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and drives the cue ball on.
Side spin changes the angle the cue ball takes off a cushion.
A raised cue drives the cue ball down into the bed, and it bounces up over the ball in the way.
A steep cue with side spin makes the cue ball curve as the spin grips the cloth.

translations.key: Then the cue ball must touch %@.
translations.text: Después la bola blanca tiene que tocar %@.

translations.key: Then the cue ball must touch %@.
translations.text: Ensuite, la bille blanche doit toucher %@.

translations.key: Then the cue ball must touch %@.
translations.text: Danach muss die weiße Kugel %@ berühren.

translations.key: Then the cue ball must touch %@.
translations.text: Poi la bianca deve toccare %@.

translations.key: Then the cue ball must touch %@.
translations.text: Depois a bola branca tem de tocar %@.

translations.key: Then the cue ball must touch %@.
translations.text: Depois a bola branca precisa tocar %@.

translations.key: Then the cue ball must touch %@.
translations.text: そのあと手玉が%@に当たるようにしよう。

translations.key: Then the cue ball must touch %@.
translations.text: 그다음 수구가 %@에 닿아야 해.

translations.key: Then the cue ball must touch %@.
translations.text: 然后母球要碰到%@。

translations.key: Then the cue ball must touch %@.
translations.text: Потом биток должен коснуться: %@.

translations.key: Then the cue ball must touch %@.
translations.text: بعدها يجب أن تلمس الكرة البيضاء %@.

translations.key: Then stop the cue ball on the mark, lined up on %@.
translations.text: Después deja la bola blanca en la marca, en línea con %@.

translations.key: Then stop the cue ball on the mark, lined up on %@.
translations.text: Puis arrête la bille blanche sur la marque, alignée sur %@.

translations.key: Then stop the cue ball on the mark, lined up on %@.
translations.text: Dann halte die weiße Kugel auf der Markierung an, in Linie mit %@.

translations.key: Then stop the cue ball on the mark, lined up on %@.
translations.text: Poi ferma la bianca sul segno, in linea con %@.

translations.key: Then stop the cue ball on the mark, lined up on %@.
translations.text: Depois para a bola branca na marca, alinhada com %@.

translations.key: Then stop the cue ball on the mark, lined up on %@.
translations.text: Depois pare a bola branca na marca, alinhada com %@.

translations.key: Then stop the cue ball on the mark, lined up on %@.
translations.text: そのあと手玉を印の上で止めて、%@を狙える位置にしよう。

translations.key: Then stop the cue ball on the mark, lined up on %@.
translations.text: 그다음 수구를 표시 위에 세워 %@와 일직선이 되게 해.

translations.key: Then stop the cue ball on the mark, lined up on %@.
translations.text: 然后让母球停在标记上，正对%@。

translations.key: Then stop the cue ball on the mark, lined up on %@.
translations.text: Потом останови биток на метке, на одной линии с: %@.

translations.key: Then stop the cue ball on the mark, lined up on %@.
translations.text: ثم أوقف الكرة البيضاء على العلامة، على خط واحد مع %@.

translations.key: The object ball leaves along the line through both centres at contact. Aim so that line runs into the pocket.
translations.text: La bola objetivo sale por la línea que une los dos centros en el contacto. Apunta para que esa línea vaya a la tronera.

translations.key: The object ball leaves along the line through both centres at contact. Aim so that line runs into the pocket.
translations.text: La bille visée part le long de la ligne qui relie les deux centres au contact. Vise pour que cette ligne aille dans la poche.

translations.key: The object ball leaves along the line through both centres at contact. Aim so that line runs into the pocket.
translations.text: Die Objektkugel läuft beim Kontakt entlang der Linie durch beide Mittelpunkte. Ziele so, dass diese Linie ins Loch führt.

translations.key: The object ball leaves along the line through both centres at contact. Aim so that line runs into the pocket.
translations.text: La bilia colpita parte lungo la linea che unisce i due centri al contatto. Mira in modo che quella linea finisca in buca.

translations.key: The object ball leaves along the line through both centres at contact. Aim so that line runs into the pocket.
translations.text: A bola objeto sai pela linha que une os dois centros no contacto. Aponta para que essa linha entre no buraco.

translations.key: The object ball leaves along the line through both centres at contact. Aim so that line runs into the pocket.
translations.text: A bola da vez sai pela linha que une os dois centros no contato. Mire para que essa linha vá para a caçapa.

translations.key: The object ball leaves along the line through both centres at contact. Aim so that line runs into the pocket.
translations.text: 的球は、当たった瞬間の両球の中心を結ぶ線に沿って進む。その線がポケットに向かうように狙おう。

translations.key: The object ball leaves along the line through both centres at contact. Aim so that line runs into the pocket.
translations.text: 목적구는 맞는 순간 두 공의 중심을 잇는 선을 따라 나가. 그 선이 포켓으로 향하게 겨눠.

translations.key: The object ball leaves along the line through both centres at contact. Aim so that line runs into the pocket.
translations.text: 目标球沿着接触时两球球心的连线离开。瞄准时让这条线指向袋口。

translations.key: The object ball leaves along the line through both centres at contact. Aim so that line runs into the pocket.
translations.text: Прицельный шар уходит по линии через оба центра в момент удара. Целься так, чтобы эта линия шла в лузу.

translations.key: The object ball leaves along the line through both centres at contact. Aim so that line runs into the pocket.
translations.text: تنطلق الكرة المستهدفة على الخط المار بمركزي الكرتين لحظة التلامس. صوّب بحيث يتجه هذا الخط إلى الجيب.

translations.key: A ball leaves a cushion at about the angle it came in, so aim at the pocket's mirror image in that cushion.
translations.text: Una bola sale de la banda más o menos con el ángulo con que llegó, así que apunta a la imagen de la tronera reflejada en esa banda.

translations.key: A ball leaves a cushion at about the angle it came in, so aim at the pocket's mirror image in that cushion.
translations.text: Une bille quitte la bande à peu près sous l'angle d'arrivée : vise le reflet de la poche dans cette bande.

translations.key: A ball leaves a cushion at about the angle it came in, so aim at the pocket's mirror image in that cushion.
translations.text: Eine Kugel verlässt die Bande ungefähr im Winkel, in dem sie kam. Ziele also auf das Spiegelbild des Lochs in dieser Bande.

translations.key: A ball leaves a cushion at about the angle it came in, so aim at the pocket's mirror image in that cushion.
translations.text: Una bilia lascia la sponda più o meno con l'angolo con cui è arrivata, quindi mira all'immagine riflessa della buca in quella sponda.

translations.key: A ball leaves a cushion at about the angle it came in, so aim at the pocket's mirror image in that cushion.
translations.text: Uma bola sai da tabela mais ou menos no ângulo em que chegou, por isso aponta para a imagem do buraco refletida nessa tabela.

translations.key: A ball leaves a cushion at about the angle it came in, so aim at the pocket's mirror image in that cushion.
translations.text: Uma bola sai da tabela mais ou menos no ângulo em que chegou, então mire na imagem da caçapa refletida nessa tabela.

translations.key: A ball leaves a cushion at about the angle it came in, so aim at the pocket's mirror image in that cushion.
translations.text: 球はクッションに入ってきたのとほぼ同じ角度で跳ね返る。だからそのクッションに映したポケットの鏡像を狙おう。

translations.key: A ball leaves a cushion at about the angle it came in, so aim at the pocket's mirror image in that cushion.
translations.text: 공은 쿠션에 들어온 각도와 거의 같은 각도로 나가. 그러니 그 쿠션에 비친 포켓의 거울상을 겨눠.

translations.key: A ball leaves a cushion at about the angle it came in, so aim at the pocket's mirror image in that cushion.
translations.text: 球离开库边的角度大约等于入射角，所以瞄准袋口在这条库边上的镜像。

translations.key: A ball leaves a cushion at about the angle it came in, so aim at the pocket's mirror image in that cushion.
translations.text: Шар отходит от борта примерно под тем же углом, под каким пришёл, поэтому целься в зеркальное отражение лузы в этом борту.

translations.key: A ball leaves a cushion at about the angle it came in, so aim at the pocket's mirror image in that cushion.
translations.text: تترك الكرة الحافة بزاوية قريبة من زاوية وصولها، لذا صوّب نحو صورة الجيب المنعكسة في تلك الحافة.

translations.key: The cue ball comes off the cushion at about its mirror angle, so it can reach a ball it cannot see straight.
translations.text: La bola blanca sale de la banda más o menos con el ángulo reflejado, así que alcanza una bola que no ve en línea recta.

translations.key: The cue ball comes off the cushion at about its mirror angle, so it can reach a ball it cannot see straight.
translations.text: La bille blanche repart de la bande à peu près sous l'angle miroir : elle peut atteindre une bille qu'elle ne voit pas en ligne droite.

translations.key: The cue ball comes off the cushion at about its mirror angle, so it can reach a ball it cannot see straight.
translations.text: Die weiße Kugel verlässt die Bande ungefähr im Spiegelwinkel und erreicht so eine Kugel, die sie nicht direkt sieht.

translations.key: The cue ball comes off the cushion at about its mirror angle, so it can reach a ball it cannot see straight.
translations.text: La bianca esce dalla sponda più o meno con l'angolo speculare, così raggiunge una bilia che non vede in linea retta.

translations.key: The cue ball comes off the cushion at about its mirror angle, so it can reach a ball it cannot see straight.
translations.text: A bola branca sai da tabela mais ou menos no ângulo espelhado, por isso chega a uma bola que não vê em linha reta.

translations.key: The cue ball comes off the cushion at about its mirror angle, so it can reach a ball it cannot see straight.
translations.text: A bola branca sai da tabela mais ou menos no ângulo espelhado, então alcança uma bola que não enxerga em linha reta.

translations.key: The cue ball comes off the cushion at about its mirror angle, so it can reach a ball it cannot see straight.
translations.text: 手玉はクッションからほぼ鏡のような角度で出ていくので、まっすぐには見えない球にも届く。

translations.key: The cue ball comes off the cushion at about its mirror angle, so it can reach a ball it cannot see straight.
translations.text: 수구는 쿠션에서 거의 거울 같은 각도로 나와서, 곧장 보이지 않는 공에도 닿을 수 있어.

translations.key: The cue ball comes off the cushion at about its mirror angle, so it can reach a ball it cannot see straight.
translations.text: 母球以大约镜面对称的角度离开库边，所以能碰到直线上看不到的球。

translations.key: The cue ball comes off the cushion at about its mirror angle, so it can reach a ball it cannot see straight.
translations.text: Биток отходит от борта примерно под зеркальным углом и достаёт шар, которого не видно напрямую.

translations.key: The cue ball comes off the cushion at about its mirror angle, so it can reach a ball it cannot see straight.
translations.text: تخرج الكرة البيضاء من الحافة بزاوية قريبة من الزاوية المنعكسة، فتصل إلى كرة لا تراها في خط مستقيم.

translations.key: Each ball sends the next along the line through their centres, so line up the last contact first.
translations.text: Cada bola manda a la siguiente por la línea que une sus centros, así que alinea primero el último contacto.

translations.key: Each ball sends the next along the line through their centres, so line up the last contact first.
translations.text: Chaque bille envoie la suivante le long de la ligne qui relie leurs centres : aligne d'abord le dernier contact.

translations.key: Each ball sends the next along the line through their centres, so line up the last contact first.
translations.text: Jede Kugel schickt die nächste entlang der Linie durch ihre Mittelpunkte. Richte also zuerst den letzten Kontakt aus.

translations.key: Each ball sends the next along the line through their centres, so line up the last contact first.
translations.text: Ogni bilia manda la successiva lungo la linea che unisce i loro centri, quindi allinea prima l'ultimo contatto.

translations.key: Each ball sends the next along the line through their centres, so line up the last contact first.
translations.text: Cada bola manda a seguinte pela linha que une os seus centros, por isso alinha primeiro o último contacto.

translations.key: Each ball sends the next along the line through their centres, so line up the last contact first.
translations.text: Cada bola manda a seguinte pela linha que une os centros, então alinhe primeiro o último contato.

translations.key: Each ball sends the next along the line through their centres, so line up the last contact first.
translations.text: それぞれの球は中心を結ぶ線に沿って次の球を送り出す。だから最後の当たりから先に合わせよう。

translations.key: Each ball sends the next along the line through their centres, so line up the last contact first.
translations.text: 각 공은 두 중심을 잇는 선을 따라 다음 공을 보내. 그러니 마지막 충돌부터 먼저 맞춰.

translations.key: Each ball sends the next along the line through their centres, so line up the last contact first.
translations.text: 每颗球都沿两球球心的连线把下一颗球送出，所以先对准最后一次碰撞。

translations.key: Each ball sends the next along the line through their centres, so line up the last contact first.
translations.text: Каждый шар посылает следующий по линии через их центры, поэтому сначала выстрой последнее касание.

translations.key: Each ball sends the next along the line through their centres, so line up the last contact first.
translations.text: كل كرة ترسل التالية على الخط المار بمركزيهما، لذا رتّب آخر تلامس أولًا.

translations.key: After a cut, a stunned cue ball leaves at right angles to the object ball's path. That sends it on to the second ball.
translations.text: Tras un corte, una bola blanca sin efecto sale en ángulo recto con la trayectoria de la bola tocada. Eso la lleva a la segunda bola.

translations.key: After a cut, a stunned cue ball leaves at right angles to the object ball's path. That sends it on to the second ball.
translations.text: Après une coupe, une bille blanche sans effet part à angle droit de la trajectoire de la bille touchée. C'est ce qui l'envoie vers la deuxième bille.

translations.key: After a cut, a stunned cue ball leaves at right angles to the object ball's path. That sends it on to the second ball.
translations.text: Nach einem Schnitt läuft eine weiße Kugel ohne Effet im rechten Winkel zur Bahn der getroffenen Kugel weg. So erreicht sie die zweite Kugel.

translations.key: After a cut, a stunned cue ball leaves at right angles to the object ball's path. That sends it on to the second ball.
translations.text: Dopo un taglio, una bianca senza effetto parte ad angolo retto rispetto al percorso della bilia colpita. È così che arriva alla seconda bilia.

translations.key: After a cut, a stunned cue ball leaves at right angles to the object ball's path. That sends it on to the second ball.
translations.text: Depois de um corte, uma bola branca sem efeito sai em ângulo reto com a trajetória da bola tocada. É isso que a leva à segunda bola.

translations.key: After a cut, a stunned cue ball leaves at right angles to the object ball's path. That sends it on to the second ball.
translations.text: Depois de um corte, uma bola branca sem efeito sai em ângulo reto com a trajetória da bola tocada. É isso que a leva até a segunda bola.

translations.key: After a cut, a stunned cue ball leaves at right angles to the object ball's path. That sends it on to the second ball.
translations.text: 薄く当てたとき、回転のない手玉は的球の進路と直角に出ていく。それで二つ目の球に向かう。

translations.key: After a cut, a stunned cue ball leaves at right angles to the object ball's path. That sends it on to the second ball.
translations.text: 얇게 맞히면 회전 없는 수구는 목적구의 진로와 직각으로 나가. 그래서 두 번째 공으로 가.

translations.key: After a cut, a stunned cue ball leaves at right angles to the object ball's path. That sends it on to the second ball.
translations.text: 切球之后，不带旋转的母球会沿着与目标球路线成直角的方向离开，于是去碰第二颗球。

translations.key: After a cut, a stunned cue ball leaves at right angles to the object ball's path. That sends it on to the second ball.
translations.text: После среза биток без вращения уходит под прямым углом к пути прицельного шара. Так он и идёт ко второму шару.

translations.key: After a cut, a stunned cue ball leaves at right angles to the object ball's path. That sends it on to the second ball.
translations.text: بعد الضربة المائلة، تخرج الكرة البيضاء بلا دوران بزاوية قائمة مع مسار الكرة المضروبة، فتتجه إلى الكرة الثانية.

translations.key: Balls that grip as they touch drag each other sideways, so a ball can be thrown off its straight line.
translations.text: Las bolas que se agarran al tocarse se arrastran de lado, así que una bola puede desviarse de su línea recta.

translations.key: Balls that grip as they touch drag each other sideways, so a ball can be thrown off its straight line.
translations.text: Des billes qui accrochent au contact s'entraînent de côté : une bille peut ainsi être déviée de sa ligne droite.

translations.key: Balls that grip as they touch drag each other sideways, so a ball can be thrown off its straight line.
translations.text: Kugeln, die beim Kontakt aneinander haften, ziehen sich seitlich mit. So lässt sich eine Kugel von ihrer geraden Linie abdrängen.

translations.key: Balls that grip as they touch drag each other sideways, so a ball can be thrown off its straight line.
translations.text: Le bilie che fanno presa quando si toccano si trascinano di lato, così una bilia può essere spinta fuori dalla sua linea retta.

translations.key: Balls that grip as they touch drag each other sideways, so a ball can be thrown off its straight line.
translations.text: Bolas que se agarram ao tocar arrastam-se de lado, por isso uma bola pode ser desviada da sua linha reta.

translations.key: Balls that grip as they touch drag each other sideways, so a ball can be thrown off its straight line.
translations.text: Bolas que se agarram ao se tocar arrastam uma à outra de lado, então uma bola pode ser desviada da linha reta.

translations.key: Balls that grip as they touch drag each other sideways, so a ball can be thrown off its straight line.
translations.text: 触れた瞬間に摩擦で食いつく球どうしは互いを横に引っぱる。だから球をまっすぐな線からずらせる。

translations.key: Balls that grip as they touch drag each other sideways, so a ball can be thrown off its straight line.
translations.text: 닿는 순간 서로 붙잡는 공들은 서로를 옆으로 끌어. 그래서 공을 직선에서 비껴 보낼 수 있어.

translations.key: Balls that grip as they touch drag each other sideways, so a ball can be thrown off its straight line.
translations.text: 接触时相互咬住的球会把彼此向侧面带，所以球可以被带离直线。

translations.key: Balls that grip as they touch drag each other sideways, so a ball can be thrown off its straight line.
translations.text: Шары, которые сцепляются при касании, тянут друг друга вбок, и шар можно увести с прямой линии.

translations.key: Balls that grip as they touch drag each other sideways, so a ball can be thrown off its straight line.
translations.text: الكرات التي تتماسك عند التلامس تسحب بعضها جانبًا، فيمكن إبعاد الكرة عن خطها المستقيم.

translations.key: Backspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and pulls the cue ball back.
translations.text: El efecto bajo sigue actuando después del golpe: se agarra al paño y trae la bola blanca hacia atrás.

translations.key: Backspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and pulls the cue ball back.
translations.text: L'effet rétro continue d'agir après le choc : il accroche le tapis et ramène la bille blanche en arrière.

translations.key: Backspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and pulls the cue ball back.
translations.text: Rückwärtsdrall wirkt nach dem Treffer weiter: Er greift ins Tuch und zieht die weiße Kugel zurück.

translations.key: Backspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and pulls the cue ball back.
translations.text: L'effetto a scendere continua a lavorare dopo il colpo: fa presa sul panno e riporta indietro la bianca.

translations.key: Backspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and pulls the cue ball back.
translations.text: O efeito para trás continua a atuar depois do toque: agarra o pano e puxa a bola branca de volta.

translations.key: Backspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and pulls the cue ball back.
translations.text: O efeito para trás continua agindo depois da tacada: agarra no pano e puxa a bola branca de volta.

translations.key: Backspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and pulls the cue ball back.
translations.text: 引き球の回転は当たったあとも働き続け、ラシャをつかんで手玉を引き戻す。

translations.key: Backspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and pulls the cue ball back.
translations.text: 백스핀은 맞힌 뒤에도 계속 작용해. 천을 붙잡고 수구를 뒤로 끌어와.

translations.key: Backspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and pulls the cue ball back.
translations.text: 下旋在击球后继续起作用：它咬住台呢，把母球拉回来。

translations.key: Backspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and pulls the cue ball back.
translations.text: Нижнее вращение работает и после удара: оно цепляется за сукно и тянет биток назад.

translations.key: Backspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and pulls the cue ball back.
translations.text: يستمر الدوران الخلفي بعد الضربة: يتمسك بالقماش ويسحب الكرة البيضاء إلى الوراء.

translations.key: Topspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and drives the cue ball on.
translations.text: El efecto alto sigue actuando después del golpe: se agarra al paño y empuja la bola blanca hacia delante.

translations.key: Topspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and drives the cue ball on.
translations.text: L'effet coulé continue d'agir après le choc : il accroche le tapis et pousse la bille blanche vers l'avant.

translations.key: Topspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and drives the cue ball on.
translations.text: Vorwärtsdrall wirkt nach dem Treffer weiter: Er greift ins Tuch und treibt die weiße Kugel weiter.

translations.key: Topspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and drives the cue ball on.
translations.text: L'effetto a seguire continua a lavorare dopo il colpo: fa presa sul panno e spinge avanti la bianca.

translations.key: Topspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and drives the cue ball on.
translations.text: O efeito para a frente continua a atuar depois do toque: agarra o pano e empurra a bola branca em frente.

translations.key: Topspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and drives the cue ball on.
translations.text: O efeito para a frente continua agindo depois da tacada: agarra no pano e leva a bola branca adiante.

translations.key: Topspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and drives the cue ball on.
translations.text: 押し球の回転は当たったあとも働き続け、ラシャをつかんで手玉を前へ進める。

translations.key: Topspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and drives the cue ball on.
translations.text: 탑스핀은 맞힌 뒤에도 계속 작용해. 천을 붙잡고 수구를 앞으로 밀어.

translations.key: Topspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and drives the cue ball on.
translations.text: 上旋在击球后继续起作用：它咬住台呢，推着母球向前。

translations.key: Topspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and drives the cue ball on.
translations.text: Верхнее вращение работает и после удара: оно цепляется за сукно и гонит биток вперёд.

translations.key: Topspin keeps working after the hit: it grips the cloth and drives the cue ball on.
translations.text: يستمر الدوران الأمامي بعد الضربة: يتمسك بالقماش ويدفع الكرة البيضاء إلى الأمام.

translations.key: Side spin changes the angle the cue ball takes off a cushion.
translations.text: El efecto lateral cambia el ángulo con que la bola blanca sale de la banda.

translations.key: Side spin changes the angle the cue ball takes off a cushion.
translations.text: L'effet latéral change l'angle sous lequel la bille blanche quitte la bande.

translations.key: Side spin changes the angle the cue ball takes off a cushion.
translations.text: Seitlicher Effet ändert den Winkel, in dem die weiße Kugel die Bande verlässt.

translations.key: Side spin changes the angle the cue ball takes off a cushion.
translations.text: L'effetto laterale cambia l'angolo con cui la bianca lascia la sponda.

translations.key: Side spin changes the angle the cue ball takes off a cushion.
translations.text: O efeito lateral muda o ângulo com que a bola branca sai da tabela.

translations.key: Side spin changes the angle the cue ball takes off a cushion.
translations.text: O efeito lateral muda o ângulo com que a bola branca sai da tabela.

translations.key: Side spin changes the angle the cue ball takes off a cushion.
translations.text: 横回転は、手玉がクッションから出ていく角度を変える。

translations.key: Side spin changes the angle the cue ball takes off a cushion.
translations.text: 옆회전은 수구가 쿠션에서 나가는 각도를 바꿔.

translations.key: Side spin changes the angle the cue ball takes off a cushion.
translations.text: 侧旋会改变母球离开库边的角度。

translations.key: Side spin changes the angle the cue ball takes off a cushion.
translations.text: Боковое вращение меняет угол, под которым биток отходит от борта.

translations.key: Side spin changes the angle the cue ball takes off a cushion.
translations.text: الدوران الجانبي يغيّر الزاوية التي تخرج بها الكرة البيضاء من الحافة.

translations.key: A raised cue drives the cue ball down into the bed, and it bounces up over the ball in the way.
translations.text: Un taco levantado empuja la bola blanca contra la mesa, y rebota por encima de la bola que estorba.

translations.key: A raised cue drives the cue ball down into the bed, and it bounces up over the ball in the way.
translations.text: Une queue levée enfonce la bille blanche dans le tapis, et elle rebondit par-dessus la bille gênante.

translations.key: A raised cue drives the cue ball down into the bed, and it bounces up over the ball in the way.
translations.text: Ein angehobenes Queue drückt die weiße Kugel in den Tisch, und sie springt über die Kugel im Weg.

translations.key: A raised cue drives the cue ball down into the bed, and it bounces up over the ball in the way.
translations.text: Una stecca alzata spinge la bianca contro il piano, e lei rimbalza sopra la bilia che ostacola.

translations.key: A raised cue drives the cue ball down into the bed, and it bounces up over the ball in the way.
translations.text: Um taco levantado empurra a bola branca contra a mesa, e ela salta por cima da bola que está no caminho.

translations.key: A raised cue drives the cue ball down into the bed, and it bounces up over the ball in the way.
translations.text: Um taco levantado empurra a bola branca contra a mesa, e ela pula por cima da bola no caminho.

translations.key: A raised cue drives the cue ball down into the bed, and it bounces up over the ball in the way.
translations.text: キューを立てると手玉は台に押しつけられ、跳ね上がって邪魔な球を越える。

translations.key: A raised cue drives the cue ball down into the bed, and it bounces up over the ball in the way.
translations.text: 큐를 세우면 수구가 바닥으로 눌렸다가 튀어 올라 앞을 막은 공을 넘어가.

translations.key: A raised cue drives the cue ball down into the bed, and it bounces up over the ball in the way.
translations.text: 抬高球杆会把母球压向台面，它反弹起来越过挡路的球。

translations.key: A raised cue drives the cue ball down into the bed, and it bounces up over the ball in the way.
translations.text: Поднятый кий вдавливает биток в стол, и он подскакивает над шаром на пути.

translations.key: A raised cue drives the cue ball down into the bed, and it bounces up over the ball in the way.
translations.text: العصا المرفوعة تدفع الكرة البيضاء نحو سطح الطاولة، فترتد قافزة فوق الكرة التي في الطريق.

translations.key: A steep cue with side spin makes the cue ball curve as the spin grips the cloth.
translations.text: Un taco muy inclinado con efecto lateral hace que la bola blanca se curve cuando el efecto se agarra al paño.

translations.key: A steep cue with side spin makes the cue ball curve as the spin grips the cloth.
translations.text: Une queue très inclinée avec de l'effet latéral fait courber la bille blanche quand l'effet accroche le tapis.

translations.key: A steep cue with side spin makes the cue ball curve as the spin grips the cloth.
translations.text: Ein steiles Queue mit seitlichem Effet lässt die weiße Kugel eine Kurve laufen, sobald der Drall ins Tuch greift.

translations.key: A steep cue with side spin makes the cue ball curve as the spin grips the cloth.
translations.text: Una stecca molto inclinata con effetto laterale fa curvare la bianca quando l'effetto fa presa sul panno.

translations.key: A steep cue with side spin makes the cue ball curve as the spin grips the cloth.
translations.text: Um taco muito inclinado com efeito lateral faz a bola branca curvar quando o efeito agarra o pano.

translations.key: A steep cue with side spin makes the cue ball curve as the spin grips the cloth.
translations.text: Um taco bem inclinado com efeito lateral faz a bola branca curvar quando o efeito agarra no pano.

translations.key: A steep cue with side spin makes the cue ball curve as the spin grips the cloth.
translations.text: キューを大きく立てて横回転をかけると、回転がラシャをつかんで手玉が曲がる。

translations.key: A steep cue with side spin makes the cue ball curve as the spin grips the cloth.
translations.text: 큐를 가파르게 세우고 옆회전을 주면, 회전이 천을 붙잡으면서 수구가 휘어져.

translations.key: A steep cue with side spin makes the cue ball curve as the spin grips the cloth.
translations.text: 陡立的球杆加上侧旋，会让旋转咬住台呢，使母球走出弧线。

translations.key: A steep cue with side spin makes the cue ball curve as the spin grips the cloth.
translations.text: Крутой кий с боковым вращением заставляет биток изгибаться, когда вращение цепляется за сукно.

translations.key: A steep cue with side spin makes the cue ball curve as the spin grips the cloth.
translations.text: العصا شديدة الميل مع الدوران الجانبي تجعل الكرة البيضاء تنحني حين يتمسك الدوران بالقماش.
